drivingQuestion: Is slaughter with a serrated harvest sickle valid when the knife is drawn in the direction in which its teeth incline?
outcomeNote: A mishna recording an unresolved dispute between the houses, with an agreed final clause; the gemara that follows limits Beit Hillel's validation.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹחֵט בְּמַגַּל קָצִיר, בַּדֶּרֶךְ הֲלִיכָתָהּ – בֵּית שַׁמַּאי פּוֹסְלִין, וּבֵית הִלֵּל מַכְשִׁירִין. וְאִם הֶחְלִיקוּ שִׁינֶּיהָ – הֲרֵי הִיא כְּסַכִּין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who slaughters» an animal «with a harvest sickle,» which is serrated with its teeth inclined considerably in one direction, «in a forward direction,» where the serrations do not tear the flesh, «Beit Shammai deem» the slaughter «not valid and Beit Hillel deem» it «valid. And» they both agree that «if they smoothed its serrations» so that they do not tear the flesh, its halakhic status «is like» that of «a knife» and one may slaughter with it.
